build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (registered in nx.json). Emits CommonJS-only (tsconfig.build.json -> tsconfig.lib.json sets module=commonjs) into {projectRoot}/dist/index.js + index.d.ts, per adhd ADR-0003. rootDir=src so the entry lands at dist/index.js (not dist/src/index.js). DELIBERATELY no `--baseUrl {projectRoot}`: re-basing tsconfig.base.json's repo-root-relative `paths` against THIS package dir makes every `@adhd/*` import fall through to a per-package `node_modules/@adhd/*` symlink, so the build dies with TS2307 (resolver.ts:7, permissions.ts:1) the moment that symlink is absent — a fresh checkout/worktree, or a newly-merged package before `pnpm install`. tsconfig.build.json instead maps the one workspace dep to its BUILT DECLARATION, which `^build` guarantees, so compilation no longer depends on an optional workspace symlink (adhd ADR-0002).

typecheck.//: Overrides the plugin-inferred typecheck (which dependedOn build, forming a build->typecheck->build cycle). Runs in --noEmit mode; no cycle.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (packages/agent/agent-core-native-tooling/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 98142eab instance 3: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see (nx.json production namedInput excludes it). The ratchet baselines existing spec-tsconfig errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/agent-core-native-tooling.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target. dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build (workspace test targetDefaults) are relisted. DELIBERATELY no `build`: coupling the unit suite to `build` meant a red build SKIPPED every unit test ('tasks not run because dependencies failed'), hiding real test signal behind a build failure. The built-artifact proof (ADR-0003 / NAT-TOOL-2 AC5) lives in the default-running `verify-dist-load` gate, which require()/import()s the real dist entry; the public-surface barrel contract is asserted at SOURCE in src/index.spec.ts. A unit run therefore never depends on a prior artifact. The command is overridden because this package's vitest config is `.mts` while the workspace targetDefaults hardcodes `.ts`.

e2e.//: Subprocess / real-server lane (backlog 5b839b90 AC1; docs/decisions/0009-test-lanes-unit-vs-e2e.md; 0ba70e47 AC3b). Runs ONLY src/**/*.e2e.ts and src/**/*.e2e.test.ts via vitest.e2e.config.ts; the unit `test` target excludes those files. Reached by the push/CI gate (`nx affected -t e2e --parallel=1`) and by `publish`/`nx-release-publish`. Its own pipeline stage, never in `nx test`; not env-gated. NOT cached (cache:false, 0ba70e47 L6): the result depends on uvx, PyPI reachability and the installed srt version, none of which are nx inputs, so a cached green could mask an external regression. Spawns the real `srt` (workspace dependency) and `uvx mcp-shell-server`; no built artifact of this project is executed (the suite imports src), so only ^build is needed.
